entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2 07-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Chandra Bhushan Prasad learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Saharsa Sadar P.S. Case No. 625 of 2024,
dated 22.06.2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 384, 420, 120(B) and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned A.P.P., at the outset, submits that the offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against the petitioner carry punishment of seven years and less.
4. The said submission of the learned A.P.P. is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner based on instruction further submits that investigation in the case against the petitioner is still continuing but then petitioner has not Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.68233 of 2024(2) dt.07-10-2024 been given the benefit of Section 41(A)
of the Cr.P.C., on which learned A.P.P. submits that the case be disposed of in terms of the order dated 13.02.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari Vs. The State of Bihar).
6.

sentences.text: In view of the submissions made by the learned A.P.P., the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13.02.2024 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 3536 of 2024.
